classification.difficultyReason: Identifies right-angled faces in a pyramid whose vertex is above a base corner, finds edge lengths using Pythagoras, and sums unequal triangular face areas and the base.

content.prompt: In the diagram, $VABCD$ is a square pyramid, with vertex $V$ directly above $D$. If $AB=8\text{ cm}$ and $VD=6\text{ cm}$:

spec.description: Square pyramid with V vertically above D; D and C are the front base vertices, A and B the rear vertices. Hidden edges DA, AB and VA are dashed. Double ticks identify DC and CB; supplied right-angle markers are retained at D and C. Ordinary source blue and red edge colours become black, with hidden-edge dashes preserving their meaning.
spec.mathematics: AB=BC=CD=DA=8 cm; VD=6 cm perpendicular to the base. Visible edges are VD, VC, VB, DC and CB. No base diagonals are drawn.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied vertex labels, equality ticks and right-angle marks are visible.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Name each triangle in the diagram and state what type of triangle it is.

answer.short: $\triangle VDA$, $\triangle VAB$, $\triangle VCB$ and $\triangle VDC$ are all right-angled triangles.
answer.worked:
$VD$ is perpendicular to the square base, so $\triangle VDA$ and $\triangle VDC$ are right-angled at $D$.

$AB$ is perpendicular to both $AD$ and $DV$, so it is perpendicular to $AV$; $\triangle VAB$ is right-angled at $A$. Similarly, $CB$ is perpendicular to $CV$, so $\triangle VCB$ is right-angled at $C$.

In right-angled triangle $VCB$, $CB=8\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}VB^2&=VC^2+CB^2\\VB^2&=10^2+8^2\\VB^2&=164\\VB&=2\sqrt{41}\text{ cm}\\VB&\approx12.806\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the surface area of the pyramid.

answer.short:
$192\text{ cm}^2$.

Add the square base and the four right-angled triangular faces.
answer.worked:
The faces $VDA$ and $VDC$ each have perpendicular sides $6\text{ cm}$ and $8\text{ cm}$. The faces $VAB$ and $VCB$ each have perpendicular sides $10\text{ cm}$ and $8\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_{VDA}=A_{VDC}&=\frac12\times6\times8\\A_{VDA}=A_{VDC}&=24\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}A_{VAB}=A_{VCB}&=\frac12\times10\times8\\A_{VAB}=A_{VCB}&=40\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}A_{ABCD}&=8\times8\\A_{ABCD}&=64\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Surface area}&=2\times24+2\times40+64\\\text{Surface area}&=192\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
